Markets.title: ETMarkets Smart Talk | Have ₹1 crore for 3 years? Puneet Pal’s fixed-income playbook

Markets.summary: The U.S. dollar weakened against major currencies as soft economic data led traders to scale back expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantees for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) awarded government contracts. Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July, driven by easing joblessness in rural areas. However, unemployment levels increased in urban centers during the same period.
